q: How is the competitor activity index calculated?
answer:
• Competitor Activity Index (id competitor_activity_index, group Competitor, unit index). Weighted competitor activity per 30 days. Price cut = 3, launch = 2, TV campaign = 1, each scaled by (1 + |price impact %| / 10). Formula: SUM(weight x (1 + |PriceImpactPct|/10)) x 30 / days in period. Lower is better. Recorded per manufacturer, not per brand.
• KPI definitions: Competitor Activity Index = Σ event weight × (1 + price impact % / 10), per 30 days. Weights: Price Cut 3, New Launch 2, TV Campaign 1. A price cut hits our sales directly; a launch adds a rival product; a TV campaign is awareness only.
• Competitor Events (id competitor_events, group Competitor, unit count). Number of competitor events (launches, price cuts, TV campaigns). Formula: COUNT(*). Lower is better. Recorded per manufacturer, not per brand.
